checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Steaming cup, cream and dark green palette
must.why: All show a steaming white cup, cream background, dark green arch.
All three texts are legible and correct in each image.
Same cup, arch, serif type and pill button across all.

must.item: Layout fits canvas, no stretching or clipping
must.why: Layouts are rearranged sensibly. The vertical has some blank space at the bottom and top, and the cup is slightly cropped by the arch, but it is acceptable.

faults.what: The slogan is small in the square and vertical versions, so it is less legible.
The cup and saucer bottom edge is cut by the arch, so the saucer extends past the arch. This looks slightly odd.

summary: Three cohesive cream-and-green steaming-cup ads in 1:1, 9:16 and 16:9 with all text exact; only small issues, such as small slogan text and low resolution.
